thread:
Maya L: heads up — noticed a spike of model pull failures in eu-west1 around 09:12 UTC, lots of pods stuck retrying artifact downloads :grimacing:
Kevin H: saw that, alerted by retry alert. Any common error in the kube events/logs?
Maya L: kube events show ImagePullBackOff for model-downloader sidecar. logs from sidecar show outbound requests hitting our egress-gateway and getting 403s
Jules P: can you paste the envoy/egress gateway log?
Maya L: here's the relevant tail:
```
[2025-06-12T09:12:21Z] envoy proxy outbound request cluster=s3-eu-west host=s3.eu-west-1.amazonaws.com path=/models/redwood/v2/checksum status=403 filter_chain_match: egress-gateway policy deny
2025-06-12T09:12:21Z] router: upstream reset, code=403
```
Lia R: hm 403 from gateway implies a policy mismatch. Did the egress gateway recently get the new namespace allowlist?
Kevin H: we rolled a mesh policy change last night to tighten external egress for private namespaces (copied from compliance PR). Might be too strict and not include our model storage buckets.
SRE Oncall: OpsBot just fired: alert/model-pulling-failure eu-west1 (severity=high)
OpsBot: alert sent to #eng-sre and #eng-infra at 09:13:02 UTC
Maya L: impact: ~120 pods queued for model download, several GPU nodes underutilized because containers never reached running stage — visible smoothed cost bump from retries
Jules P: quick check — is outboundTrafficPolicy set to REGISTRY_ONLY in the mesh config for that cluster? That would block non-registered external hosts unless we created ServiceEntry for s3 endpoints.
Kevin H: confirmed: mesh config in eu-west1 was flipped to REGISTRY_ONLY as part of the lockdown change. We didn't add ServiceEntry for our artifact store. oops.
Lia R: proposed quick mitigation: add ServiceEntry for s3.eu-west-1.amazonaws.com + our cdn/backup buckets and patch egress-gateway Role to allow host. Then roll canary.
Maya L: can we instead allow model-downloader-ns via namespace annotation to bypass egress gateway until we patch infra? Short lived exception.
Jules P: namespace annotation bypass would be `sidecar.istio.io/outboundTrafficPolicy: "ALLOW_ANY"` — but that bypasses mesh controls, we should prefer ServiceEntry.
Kevin H: oncall, can you apply a minimal ServiceEntry and test? I can help with RBAC changes if needed.
SRE Oncall: applying ServiceEntry for s3.* and model-cdn domains now (patch follows). Will also update egress-gateway policy to include these hosts.
SRE Oncall: kubectl apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: networking.istio.io/v1beta1
kind: ServiceEntry
metadata:
  name: allow-s3-models
  namespace: istio-system
spec:
  hosts:
  - "s3.eu-west-1.amazonaws.com"
  - "models-cdn.redwood.example.com"
  ports:
  - number: 443
    name: https
    protocol: TLS
  resolution: DNS
EOF
Lia R: after ServiceEntry applied, confirm sidecar configs regenerated? Might need to rollout pods or wait for Istio to push config.
Maya L: confirmed rollout started; some pods transitioned to Running. model downloads resumed for ~30% so far.
Jules P: followup: why did the egress-gateway return 403 instead of routing? The gateway has an allowlist policy for external hosts; we need to update the EgressPolicy CR that maps namespaces->allowedHosts.
Kevin H: opened PR to add the model buckets to the allowlist, and added a process note to update allowlist when we onboard new artifact stores. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/egress-config/pull/412
Maya L: re: root cause — change to REGISTRY_ONLY was intentional for compliance, but rollout lacked inventory update. Also missed in runbook for model migrations.
SRE Oncall: monitoring shows egress 403 rate back to normal after allowlist update, but we'll keep alert on for 2 hours.
Lia R: action items:
- Kevin: finish PR and deploy egress allowlist update (short term)
- Jules: add a check in pre-commit that scans mesh policy changes and validates known artifact hosts are listed (automation)
- Maya: add runbook note about scheduling allowlist updates when moving artifact stores
- SRE Oncall: keep watch, roll back if other namespaces affected
Kevin H: putting PR in prod now. will ping when it's live. :rocket:
Maya L: thanks everyone — lesson: REGISTRY_ONLY + no ServiceEntry = model-pulls blocked; keep that in playbook for future lockdowns.
Jules P: also add a regression test: create a namespace that simulates model-downloader and ensure it can fetch from our model host when policy applied.
Kevin H: PR merged and deployed to eu-west1 at 09:28 UTC. Verified downloads restored.
Maya L: closing the incident but leaving the alert open for 2h as Lia said. If anything spikes, ping here. :thumbsup:
